engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Ignition Key cannot be removed from ignition switch with Transmission in Park.
PRND21 indicator is not reading correctly in the Gösterge Paneli.
Ignition Key CAN be removed from ignition switch with Transmission in ANY selector position.
commonCauses: Communication Failure with Gear Selector Module
Tiptronic Buttons (F189) in Selector Lever (E313) faulty
The N376-Ignition Key Withdrawal Lock Solenoid could have failed.
The N376 is loose in the housing.
There is electrical fault with the wiring/connectors for the N376.
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Communication with Gear Selector Module

Kontrol edin:  Selector Lever (E313)
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block (MVB) in Transmission Kontrol Modülü
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block (MVB) in Transmission Kontrol Modülü

Kontrol edin:  Tiptronic Buttons (F189) in Selector Lever (E313)
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block (MVB) in Transmission Kontrol Modülü
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block (MVB) in Transmission Kontrol Modülü
Verify the N376-Ignition Key Withdrawal Lock Solenoid is installed correctly.
Verify the N376 is not an Açık Devre / Kablo Kopukluğu'
Değiştirin / Yenileyin: d failed N376 with newest/updated part from the manufacture
technicalNotes:
Most of the above is applicable Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 2005 and newer Jetta A5, 2006 and newer Volkswagen GTI, Golf, Rabbit and EOS
Please see Volkswagen's Tech Tip (28-08-02). It states "DO NOT Değiştirin / Yenileyin: the ignition switch, lock cylinder, or lock housing assembly" before verifying the proper operation of the N376 (sometimes referred to as the 'catch')
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2013/MC-10157607-9999.pdf  NHTSA
Use Measuring Value Block Group [005] in the [16-Steering wheel] controller to verify proper operation of the N376.
Field (3) in the MVB-[005] must display [On] when any driving position is selected.
Field (4) in MVB-[005] must display [Ok]
Part number for the "catch" has been updated several times, Kontrol edin: with your local parts department for the latest and correct part for the vehicle in question.
